url.title: Source
url.description: Image URL, storeId/key for a key-value store record, or the generated sample's name.

sourceType.title: Source type
sourceType.description: url, kv (key-value store record), dataset (from datasetId) or sample (generated test image).

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: From the Content-Disposition header, the URL path or the record key.

inputFormat.title: Input format
inputFormat.description: Detected input format: jpeg, png, webp, avif, gif, tiff, bmp, heic or svg.

inputWidth.title: Input width
inputWidth.description: Input width in pixels (after EXIF rotation).

inputHeight.title: Input height
inputHeight.description: Input height in pixels (after EXIF rotation).

inputMegapixels.title: Input megapixels
inputMegapixels.description: Input width x height in millions of pixels; over 12 is billed as a large image.

savedPercent.title: Saved (%)
savedPercent.description: How much smaller the output is than the input, in percent (negative if larger).

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Encoder quality used (with targetKb, the one found); null for lossless PNG.

outputKey.title: Output key
outputKey.description: Record key of the converted image in the run's key-value store.

outputUrl.title: Converted image
outputUrl.description: Link to the converted image in the run's key-value store.

chargedEvent.title: Charged event
chargedEvent.description: image-converted (up to 12 MP) or image-converted-large; null for failures, which are free.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Notes such as an animated GIF of which only the first frame was converted, or a target size that could not be reached.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the image failed (not billed), or null on success.

convertedAt.title: Converted at
convertedAt.description: When the image was processed (ISO 8601 UTC).
